abid2009.numerical_data: Table 1 kinetic parameters; plotted time courses
abid2009.limitations: pH 8, added Mn, 10% serum; unmatched downstream products prevent full pathway calibration

kuoppala2000.perturbation: ACE pathway and CPN-like pathway inhibitor attribution
kuoppala2000.numerical_data: reported >90% pathway shares at different concentrations
kuoppala2000.limitations: no transferable vaccine rates; product shares are not a combined epitope survival fraction

yi2015.perturbation: P700/P800 proprietary inhibitor cocktails, matched collection tubes
yi2015.numerical_data: 27 Table 2 rows transcribed and auditable; supplements are six TIF figures
yi2015.limitations: multi-enzyme cocktails do not identify individual hazards; assays/concentrations mixed in some rows; no sample IDs or numeric time-course table
yi2015.donor_preparation: MS methods: pooled same three healthy subjects; table ranges span donor samples; means +/- SD from one sample in three replicates
source_discrepancies: Table 2 RT24+/-1 C; methods RT25+/-1 C; body RT24+/-2 C
Table 2 glucagon EDTA5-20h; body5-24h; preserve Table 2 values
OXM-K33 specified in methods; Table 1/2 use OXM1-37 labels

zhen2016.perturbation: FAP-selective inhibitor, immunodepletion and recombinant rescue
zhen2016.supported_scope: causal attribution of C-terminal deltaC10 cleavage to FAP
zhen2016.numerical_data: LC-MRM product identities and plotted time courses; no numeric product trajectory table located
zhen2016.limitations: 181-aa protein, not a long-vaccine-peptide rate calibrator; N-terminal DPP4-like processing separate; figure endpoint estimates not fitted
zhen2016.donor_preparation: 48-donor FAP abundance/activity panel separate from cleavage perturbation assay

bainbridge2017.matrix: human serum, mouse plasma and purified enzymes
bainbridge2017.perturbation: FAP immunodepletion; cpd60; PREP inhibitor KYP2047; mouse Fap knockout
bainbridge2017.substrates: FRET-labelled GP and D-Ala aP probes; terminal dyes/extra lysine
bainbridge2017.supported_scope: FAP causal reporter evidence and important PREP confounding of GP probe
bainbridge2017.numerical_data: relative fluorescence rate figures; 2-page supplement has inhibitor structures
bainbridge2017.limitations: labelled/noncanonical reporters do not supply free-L-vaccine kinetics; ordinary GP probe is also cleaved by PREP; murine inhibitor experiments are not human serum rates

torang2016.matrix: heparin plasma/whole blood in vitro; in vivo infusion kept separate
torang2016.perturbation: sitagliptin in vivo; EDTA/aprotinin/valine-pyrrolidide at sampling quench
torang2016.supported_scope: endpoint mismatch and fragment evidence; parent loss differs from total immunoreactivity
torang2016.numerical_data: reported in-vitro half-life and association constants; plotted trajectories
torang2016.limitations: in-vitro quench is not a digestion-time inhibitor arm; ~20% infusate already PYY3-36, so authors withhold in-vivo conversion rate; PK includes distribution/removal

nyimanu2019.supported_scope: observed products compatible with proposed MME cleavage
nyimanu2019.limitations: product identification without selective perturbation cannot isolate MME rates; multiple enzymes share endpoints; exposure is in vivo, not serum digestion

dufresne2017.perturbation: ice, ice plus broad cocktail, room-temperature degradation
dufresne2017.supported_scope: broad preanalytical peptidomics and sample handling
dufresne2017.numerical_data: 58.2MB supplemental peptide/protein matrix, CC0 data; quantitative precursor intensities and identification frequency
dufresne2017.limitations: ice/inhibitor versus warm samples confound temperature and inhibition; broad inhibitors and peptide generation/loss mix prevent enzyme-specific exogenous substrate hazard fitting
dufresne2017.license: CC-BY-4.0 article; CC0 data unless stated
dufresne2017.donor_preparation: at least ten donors per time point;170 samples,82 cold/preserved and88 warm
dufresne2017.raw_numeric_timecourses: supplemental matrix available; no matched fixed-temperature enzyme-selective panel

supplement_audit.status: download timed out; matrix not locally inspected

yi2007.supported_scope: sequential peptide generation/digestion and anticoagulant dependence
yi2007.limitations: selective multi-enzyme rate identifiability not established; full-text/supplement licensing and numeric inputs unverified

ftms2007.matrix: fractionated human plasma ultrafiltrate plus exogenous enzyme
ftms2007.perturbation: specific active protease present/absent; DPP4 inhibitor proof of concept
ftms2007.substrates: endogenous peptide pool, validated spike controls; EPLGRQLTSGP
ftms2007.supported_scope: substrate discovery and purified-enzyme kinetic validation
ftms2007.numerical_data: reported purified DPP4 kcat/Km2.3e5M^-1s^-1 for EPLGRQLTSGP
ftms2007.limitations: fractionated substrate pool plus added enzyme is not intact plasma turnover; physiological active enzyme concentration and licensing unresolved

maffioli2020.numerical_data: Table S1 numerical product data and113 unique boundary contexts; prior download hashes retained in serum_contributions.json
maffioli2020.limitations: animal/short-library transfer unvalidated; observed product boundaries are not molecular cut counts or named enzyme rates

blood2017.numerical_data: parent loss and MS product profiles
blood2017.limitations: mouse comparison does not calibrate human vaccine enzymes; serum preparation can change mechanism

conclusion: No audited dataset identifies transferable named-enzyme hazards for human long vaccine peptides and their target-bearing fragments. This is a bounded literature/data audit, not proof that no such dataset exists.
fit_decision: Preserve reported first-order parent clocks; no new enzyme hazard fit is justified by the audited inputs. Existing NPY reference kinetics remain assay-specific.

human plasma peptidomics vehicle inhibitors depletion rescue LC-MS

human serum PYY NPY GLP1 FGF21 apelin degradation fragments

minimum_experiment.substrates: Actual vaccine sequences, exact target alone, and observed target-bearing fragments; preserve terminal chemistry and mutations
minimum_experiment.matrix: Matched fresh human serum and a specified human plasma preparation; record anticoagulant/coagulation activation, donor IDs, pooling, matrix fraction, pH and37C temperature
minimum_experiment.perturbations: Same-temperature vehicle and each selective inhibitor; combination arms where nonadditivity matters; verify selectivity with activity controls and orthogonal depletion/rescue where feasible
minimum_experiment.concentrations: At least two known substrate concentrations bracketing intended assay exposure; no assumed patient concentration
minimum_experiment.sampling: Baseline plus sufficiently dense early and late time points to resolve intermediate products and substantial loss; biological donor and technical replicates with sample IDs
minimum_experiment.quantification: Calibrated LC-MS parent and identified products, stable-isotope standards, recovery and LOD/LOQ, mass balance; raw trajectories and inhibitor identity/dose reusable
minimum_experiment.fitting: Fit competing/serial substrate-scoped hazards only when perturbations and products identify them; hold out donors/sequences; parameter uncertainty separate from unknown mechanisms
minimum_experiment.vaccine_routes: Measure APC uptake and HLA-bound target separately; serum proteolysis does not calibrate RNA expression, tissue exposure or clearance
